analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 trading sessions. RSI saw a slight increase from 46.1 to 47.6 within the neutral zone (40-60), but the signal for a trend reversal remains weak. MACD histogram is improving (-526.7751 to -166.2119) but still in negative territory. ADX at 18.3 indicates a continued weakening of trend strength, entering a non-trending phase below 20. Trading volume ratio increased to 1.68x the 5-day average, but its reliability is low due to the lack of directional clarity. The 52-week position at 41.1% is within the neutral range. Neither the 5-day high/low ($84,840.05 / $80,615.4) nor the 20-day high/low ($86,971.78 / $79,735.86) have formed a clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern. The price is consolidating between the swing support at $80,659.81 and resistance at $82,262.21. While the weekly RSI at 56.9 remains strong, the weakening daily ADX suggests potential for short-term volatility. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach is prudent for further indicator confirmation.
